meta.name: json-canvas
meta.description: Create and edit JSON Canvas files (.canvas) with nodes, edges, groups, and connections. Use when working with .canvas files, creating visual canvases, mind maps, flowcharts, or when the user mentions Canvas files in Obsidian.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 创建和编辑 JSON Canvas 文件，构建可视化画布
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在 Obsidian 中创建和编辑 .canvas 文件
copy.tagline_en: Create and edit JSON Canvas files for visual canvases
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to create and edit .canvas files in Obsidian

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能创建和编辑 Obsidian 等应用使用的 .canvas 文件。它会生成符合 JSON Canvas 规范的 JSON 结构，包含文本、文件、链接、分组四类节点，以及连接它们的边，并自动处理坐标、颜色、ID 等属性。
howto.when: 当用户要求创建或编辑 .canvas 文件，绘制思维导图、流程图等可视化内容，或提到 Obsidian 的 Canvas 时触发。

say.text: 新建一个 .canvas 文件，放三个文本节点并用箭头连接。
say.note: Claude 会生成包含节点和边的 .canvas 文件。

say.text: 把这个 .canvas 里的两个节点用边连起来，加上箭头。
say.note: Claude 会修改 JSON，加入 edge 定义。

say.text: 帮我创建一个分组，里面放几个文件节点。
say.note: Claude 会生成 group 节点和文件节点。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can create and edit .canvas files used by Obsidian and other apps. It outputs JSON compliant with the JSON Canvas Spec, including text, file, link, and group nodes, and edges connecting them, while handling coordinates, colors, and IDs.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks to create or edit .canvas files, draw mind maps, flowcharts, or other visual content, or mentions Obsidian Canvas.

say_en.text: Create a .canvas file with three text nodes connected by arrows.
say_en.note: Claude will generate a canvas JSON with nodes and edges.

say_en.text: Connect two existing nodes in this .canvas with an arrow.
say_en.note: Claude will update the JSON with an edge entry.

say_en.text: Add a group node containing a few file nodes.
say_en.note: Creates a group with nested file nodes.
